# SalesSense

> > B2B sales training, consulting, and optimization services based in Exeter, UK, specializing in account management, sales methodology, and performance improvement.

SalesSense, led by Clive Miller, provides comprehensive sales effectiveness services including training courses, competency assessments, pipeline management, and sales optimization consulting. The site features free B2B sales training modules, practical sales methodology resources, and thought leadership articles on complex selling.

## Key Topics

- B2B sales training
- Account management
- Sales competencies
- Customer buying process
- Sales methodology
- Lead generation
- Sales optimization
- Pipeline management
- Questioning and listening skills
- Sales performance improvement
- Competency assessments
- Complex sale
- Telesales techniques
- Sales coaching
- Professional development
